# Prowess Software Services — full content index

> The integration and data architecture firm AI-native enterprises rely on. Two-time MuleSoft Above & Beyond Partner of the Year — Americas (2024 and 2025). Founded 2016 by Aravind Konda and Ajay Konda. 350 certified architects across Atlanta, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, and Singapore. 175+ customers across 25+ industries.

## Positioning

Prowess engineers the integration, data, and governance foundations that allow enterprise AI to move from pilot to production. The practice grew up through TIBCO and webMethods, scaled through MuleSoft, expanded into Informatica as master-data foundations became central, and added Salesforce Agentforce and MuleSoft Agent Fabric as production AI matured.

The senior architects who scope an engagement remain on it through delivery. A bench of 350 certified architects supports the model.

## EnterpriseFLOW — four fixed-fee accelerators

### Migration Sprint MuleSoft — $200K–$350K, 12–24 weeks
Migrate legacy iPaaS (TIBCO BW6, Boomi, IBM Integration Bus, webMethods, BizTalk, Jitterbit, Enosix) to MuleSoft. Includes X2M Accelerator + CurieTech AI Migration Agent (80%+ first-pass accuracy, 10× acceleration).
- Sprint A: $200K · up to 25 integrations · 12 weeks
- Sprint B: $275K · 25–75 integrations · 16 weeks
- Sprint C: $350K · 75–150 integrations · 24 weeks
- Migration Assessment: $75K–$95K, credits against Sprint
- Reference: Novelis reduced processing time by 85% on the new MuleSoft stack.

### Migration Sprint Informatica — $200K–$350K, 12–20 weeks
Modernize ETL from PowerCenter, DataStage, SSIS, or Talend onto Informatica IDMC and MDM.
- Sprint A: $200K · up to 50 pipelines, single MDM domain · 12 weeks
- Sprint B: $275K · 50–150 pipelines, 2 MDM domains · 16 weeks
- Sprint C: $350K · 150+ pipelines, 3+ MDM domains · 20 weeks
- Reference: Pacific International Lines red-to-green in 2.5 months.

### Agent Fabric Builder — $150K–$300K, 6–12 weeks
MuleSoft Agent Fabric implementation. Governance, observability, two pilot agents wired to existing systems.
- Builder A: $150K · 1 pilot agent · 6 weeks
- Builder B: $225K · 2 pilot agents + governance hardening · 8 weeks
- Builder C: $300K · + 1 custom agent + C4E kick-off · 12 weeks
- Reference: TE Connectivity 6-week pilot in Singapore.

### Implementation Accelerator — $300K–$500K, 16–28 weeks
Anypoint Platform standup, three-tier API architecture, operating C4E by day 90.
- Accelerator A: $300K · 3 System APIs + 1 Process API · 16 weeks
- Accelerator B: $400K · 5 System APIs + 2 Process APIs + 1 Experience API · 22 weeks
- Accelerator C: $500K · + 2 additional integrations + Mule 3 to Mule 4 · 28 weeks
- Reference: 120+ new MuleSoft customers onboarded in 2024.
